Also `slugify("--a--b--")` should give `"a-b"`.

The fix is complete. The changes:

1. **Collapse multiple hyphens** into a single hyphen: `re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)`
2. **Strip leading/trailing hyphens**: `text.strip("-")`

This ensures `slugify("Hello,  World!")` → `"hello-world"` (no double hyphen) and `slugify("--a--b--")` → `"a-b"` (no leading/trailing hyphens).

arguments.summary: Fixed `slugify` in `textkit/slug.py` by adding two post-processing steps: collapsing consecutive hyphens with `re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)` and stripping leading/trailing hyphens with `text.strip("-")`. This resolves the issue where `slugify("Hello,  World!")` returned `"hello--world-"` instead of `"hello-world"`, and `slugify("--a--b--")` now correctly returns `"a-b"`.
